title: Dashboard decluttered + formal color theme
detail: Removed Phoenix Cap-Rate Watch, 5302 N 35th Feasibility, Dev Underwriting Model, Field Manual, and ARC Dashboard from the nav. Swapped the bright SaaS palette for a muted navy/forest/gold theme site-wide.

title: Mail letter now pitches land-for-equity JV
detail: Letter to land leads explains, in plain terms, the option to contribute land into the development for an ownership stake instead of a cash sale. Preview card added to the top of the leads page.

title: Skip-Trace Priority min equity margin lowered to 50%
detail: Default threshold for which leads are worth paying for a skip-trace lookup dropped from 100% to 50% equity margin, qualifying more leads (62 → 87).

title: Residential/commercial zoning filter added to leads list
detail: New filter dropdown plus inline zoning-class badge on each lead, reusing the PUC-based classifier from comps.py.

title: Skip-Trace Priority card + CSV export shipped
detail: Score + equity-margin gating algorithm decides which leads are worth paying ~$0.10/record to skip-trace, with a ready-to-upload CSV export.

title: LLC owner unmasking via OpenCorporates
detail: Hidden-owner leads now resolve a registered agent name/address through a free, CAPTCHA-free Arizona filing mirror.

title: Satellite/Street View links added to each lead
detail: Manual visual condition check for teardown candidates, since public data has no reliable "house condition" signal.
